name: NxNxN Cube Filter for Gradient Smoothing
aliases: N x N x N Gradient Filtering
definition: A filtering step applied to gradients to smooth them out and prevent high irregularities. It averages the surrounding N^3 samples.
summary: This filter smooths gradient vectors by averaging neighbors in a cubic neighborhood, differing from voxel averaging by operating on vector data and from iterative methods by using a single pass.
